methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_changed_pinned_smbios_uuid_is_an_explicit_failure

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_fallback_is_created_once_and_never_switches_to_smbios

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_fallback_storage_read_failure_never_regenerates_identity

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_missing_pinned_fallback_record_is_not_regenerated

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_missing_pinned_smbios_record_is_not_recreated_from_firmware

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_corrupt_identity_record_is_not_replaced

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_invalid_identity_record_contents_are_never_replaced_or_trusted

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_existing_identity_without_marker_is_loaded_and_marked

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_machine_identity_write_permission_failure_is_explicit

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_concurrent_fallback_startup_persists_one_atomic_identity

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_concurrent_process_startup_observes_one_fallback_identity

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_uses_windows_firmware_table_api

methods.review_note: Strengthened. Original only asserted CCW signed_area == 12 and centroid at one winding, and the name claimed 'rotation pivot' while never calling rotate_position_coords. Added: reversed (CW) winding gives -12 and the same centroid, and a real 180-degree rotate_position_coords(is_area=True) check against the exact point reflection (3-x, 2-y) at 1e8 offset (delta 1e-6), proving the concave centroid (not bbox) is the pivot. Mutation-checked by patching: centroid without origin subtraction (precision loss at 1e8), bbox-centre pivot, vertex-mean pivot, abs(signed_area), half signed_area all fail; bbox pivot fails specifically in the new rotation subTest.

methods.name: ClippedTextGraphicsItemTests.test_clipped_text_item_inline_edit_bounds_use_textbox_not_text_height

Mutations caught: boundingRect returning text rect, text_bounding_rect returning clip rect.

methods.name: ClippedTextGraphicsItemTests.test_clipped_text_item_clip_rect_is_copied_and_drives_bounding_rect
methods.review_note: Added (sibling coverage of clip_rect/set_clip_rect which production relies on for inline edit): constructor and set_clip_rect copy their QRectF argument, clip_rect() returns a copy, boundingRect follows set_clip_rect. Mutations caught: clip_rect returning internal rect, set_clip_rect not copying, set_clip_rect no-op, boundingRect ignoring clip.

methods.name: ClippedTextGraphicsItemTests.test_clipped_text_annotation_paints_only_inside_textbox
methods.review_note: Strengthened. Original only checked rows y>=24 were empty (rows 18-23 and the horizontal extent unchecked, and nothing proved the text would have drawn there without the clip). Now: control render with a full-size clip proves the text extends below 18px and right of the 60px box; clip narrowed to 60x18 so horizontal clipping is exercised; asserts no pixel at y>=18 or x>=60 and that the clipped pixel set equals exactly the unclipped pixels inside the box. Mutations caught: no clipping, clip 10px too tall, clip 10px too wide (the width mutant survived the original-width version, fixed by narrowing), set_clip_rect no-op.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_high_resolution_preference_uses_pdf_baseline
methods.review_note: STRENGTHENED. Original compared INTERACTIVE (3.0) to a value that was also 3.0 when the preference was ignored (zoom 4x clamps to the 3.0 raster cap), so it was weak. Added contrast: with the preference off, scene 1.0 x zoom 0.5 resolves to 1.0 (zoom floor); with it on the same inputs resolve to the 3.0 baseline; with _can_zoom_rerender False the caller default (1.5) is used. Mutation (ignore the preference) now errors/fails.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_high_resolution_frame_scale_includes_view_scale_and_device_pixel_ratio
methods.review_note: STRENGTHENED. Exact values 2.25 (scene 3 x zoom 0.5 x DPR 1.5) and 36.0 (clamped at MAX_ZOOM 8 x 3 x 1.5) were already sound; added the lower clamp (zoom 0.001 -> CONSTRAINED_RENDER_SCALE_FLOOR 0.1).

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_frame_scale_quantization_uses_stable_log_steps
methods.review_note: STRENGTHENED. Floor (0.75->1.0), identity (1.0), and 2.01->2.181 (ceil of log2 step 0.125 = 2^1.125) were sound; added the exact step boundary 2.0->2.0 so a ceil off-by-one at a step boundary is caught.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_high_resolution_preference_disables_tiles
methods.review_note: Sound: preference on makes _update_tile_coverage clear the frame and cancel optional base correction and nothing else; the fixture has no rendering service or background item, so any extra request would raise. Exact ordered call list asserted.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_overlay_pdf_item_keeps_scene_size_when_rendered_above_view_scale
methods.review_note: Sound: 400x200 overlay pixmap on a 100x100pt page at view scale 2 gives exact 0.5/1.0 transform scales (scene size, not bitmap size) and SmoothTransformation for a PDF overlay. Mutation of the scale divisor or transformation mode fails it.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_overlay_item_uses_page_calibrated_coordinates
methods.review_note: Sound: real Page calibration (scale_factor1/2, overlay_rect) -> exact translate/scale of the overlay item; ignoring translation or calibration changes m31/m11 by orders of magnitude.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_overlay_pdf_tiles_use_page_calibrated_coordinates
methods.review_note: Sound: _overlay_pdf_tile_transform for the same calibrated page asserts translation and scale against the PDF source size; consistency with the low-res item is also asserted in PlanViewInteractionTests.test_show_both_overlay_visible_frame_transform_matches_low_res_overlay_item.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_overlay_raster_item_keeps_default_transformation_mode
methods.review_note: Sound: .png overlay stays FastTransformation (negative sibling of the PDF smooth case).

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_visible_frame_placement_uses_returned_bitmap_size_without_stretch
methods.review_note: STRENGTHENED. Exact x/y (half-pixel aligned origin) and width/height (bitmap size / render scale) were sound; added that the request id is consumed, z == PAGE_VISIBLE_FRAME_Z and the item is in the scene.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_visible_frame_quality_threshold_keeps_canonical_page_geometry
methods.review_note: Sound (kept). Loops zoom 0.50/0.54/0.56/1.0/2.0/0.54 x3 asserting background pos/rect, scene rect, and that a frame exists iff zoom > 0.54 (the 1.1 activate ratio on base scale 1.0 x scene 2). Mutating the activate ratio fails two tests. Limitation: view.transform()/scroll assertions are against stubs.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_mismatched_import_metadata_uses_native_geometry_across_zoom_cycles
methods.review_note: STRENGTHENED. Previously every per-iteration check lived behind `if request_id is not None`, so a production that never requested a frame would pass. Added the exact `frame item exists iff zoom > 0.54` assertion and a minimum count of frame requests. Native (240x160) vs stored (280x200) geometry checks, frame rects bounded by the native source, marker rect stable all retained.

methods.name: PageLoaderPreferenceTests.test_high_dpi_visible_frame_changes_sampling_not_logical_geometry

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_coalesces_pending_updates_without_losing_completion
methods.review_note: Event-synchronised: request 1 in flight, 2 and 4 coalesce to 6 and all three completions fire True in order. Added drained-bridge assertion. Mutant 'coalesce dropped' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_incompatible_pending_update_is_rejected_before_replacement
methods.review_note: Manual pool; incompatible pending is rejected (False) at replacement time, stale in-flight completes False through is_current. Strengthened: apply now records its argument and the test asserts only ('new', 4) was applied (previously apply returned True blindly). Mutants 'can_coalesce bypassed', 'superseded reported True', 'is_current skipped' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_stale_result_is_not_applied_and_submit_after_cleanup_is_rejected
methods.review_note: Renamed from ..._and_cleanup_rejects_pending: it never had a pending submission, it proves a stale result is not applied (completion False) and submit after cleanup completes False. The cleanup-with-pending behaviour is now covered by the new test below. Mutant 'submit after close accepted' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_compatible_pending_update_is_coalesced_when_can_coalesce_allows
methods.review_note: NEW: sibling of the incompatible-pending test; with can_coalesce returning True the pending request is merged ((a,2)+(a,4) -> (a,6)) and all three completions get True. Covers the can_coalesce-true branch that was untested. Mutant 'coalesce dropped' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_cleanup_rejects_in_flight_and_pending_and_ignores_late_result
methods.review_note: NEW: cleanup while one request is in flight and one pending completes both False immediately, a late bridged result is not applied and does not re-complete, a second cleanup is a no-op and no worker is started. Mutant 'cleanup not completing pending' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_cleanup_does_not_start_a_queued_worker
methods.review_note: A completion callback that calls cleanup() must not start the queued worker (one thread only, queued completion False). Sound; mutant 'start after close' is killed by the sibling start-failure test, which shares the guard.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_exception_does_not_drop_other_transactions
methods.review_note: A raising completion on transaction 1 must not stop the queued transaction 2 from running (2,True). Strengthened: the raising callback now runs under assertLogs at ERROR so the logged-failure contract is asserted and the traceback no longer leaks to stderr. Mutant 'completion exceptions unguarded' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_exception_does_not_skip_coalesced_sibling_completions
methods.review_note: NEW: a raising completion among coalesced siblings must not skip the following completion in the same transaction (guards the per-callback try/except in _invoke_completions). Mutant 'completion exceptions unguarded' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_worker_start_failure_rejects_submission_and_allows_retry
methods.review_note: Pool start raises once: submission 1 completes False and a later submission starts normally and succeeds. Strengthened: first submit now under assertLogs and asserts (1, False) before the retry is submitted, so the failure result is not conflated with the retry.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_start_failure_completion_cleanup_does_not_start_pending_work
methods.review_note: Blocking pool holds start() while a second request queues; the failed completion calls cleanup; no second start, both completions False. Event-based, deterministic. Now wrapped in assertLogs for the start failure. Mutant 'start after close' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_start_failure_starts_pending_submission_after_rejecting_failed_one
methods.review_note: NEW: when worker start fails while another request is pending, the failed one completes False and the pending one is started (start_count 2) and completes True. Mutant 'pending not started after start failure' killed.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_preparation_error_rejects_submission_without_applying

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_apply_failure_or_false_result_reports_unsuccessful_completion
